EQ, VSS Hi Cut/Hi Xover max

frequencyIndexTable.candidateFormula: f = 20 * 10^(raw/80) Hz (80 steps per decade, about 1/24 octave) fits all seven anchors within 0.5 %
frequencyIndexTable.candidateStatus: Fit computed by the reader from the anchors above; NOT printed by any manufacturer document. Do not display interior values from it before a hardware check (one passive read of a known panel value).

notes.editPageOrder: The MIDI chart (EN p.59) says CC 12 = first parameter of the Edit page, CC 13 = second, and M3K-SYX prints Ctrl = ID + 10, which implies Edit-page order = SysEx ID order. The manual's description order equals the ID order for Phaser, Compressor, Tremolo, Chorus, Pitch and Delay, but not for Flanger, Expander/Gate, De-esser, C.O.R.E., Rev-3 or the VSS algorithms; for VSS the p.24 LCD shows the easy page starting Decay, EarlyLev, RevLev, Mix, Out Level (IDs 2, 25, 26, 0, 1). Groups follow the manuals' headings and description order, not the ID order.

statusSemantics.confirmed: the manual gives the display range/unit or an ordered label list consistent with the raw range; scale.kind linear = exact law; table = endpoints only (scale.exact false); list = one label per raw step, scale.indexOrder says what the order rests on
statusSemantics.conflict: a manual statement contradicts the raw range, editions disagree with the primary reading contradicting the raw range, or the raw row <-> manual parameter pairing is ambiguous; all readings are in 'readings'; display = raw until resolved
statusSemantics.unknown: the manual is silent on the display law, or labels are printed without a usable order (scale.labelSet + indexOrder 'unknown'); display = raw

notes.readingsField: Conflict entries list readings A, B, C...; consistentWithRaw = true when that reading's display range can be laid on the raw min..max with a plausible step, false when it cannot, null when the reading is the raw range itself or an argument that proposes no display range.
notes.mappingField: How the raw row was paired with the manual label: name (raw name matches), semantic (meaning matches, e.g. TAUUP = Attack), range (unique matching range), count (enumeration size), elimination (only remaining pair); '(unconfirmed)' or '(ambiguous)' when that pairing alone is weak.
notes.indexOrderBases: LCD-numbered or LCD left-to-right lists, printed range slots '(a, b, c)' (the manuals print every numeric range slot min-first), numbered or numeric ascending lists. Prose mentions ('choose between X or Y') are not treated as an order.
notes.editionDisagreements: Where M3K-EN (Rev 3) matches the raw range and M3K-FR or M3K-ADD (REV 1.3, older) does not, the entry stays 'confirmed' and the disagreement is recorded in its note.
notes.displayUnits: unit is the unit printed by the manual for that parameter; unitHint carries a unit seen only in an example (LCD or prose) without a printed range.
notes.labelComposed: true when label_en/label_fr is composed from the manual's wording (e.g. 'Frequency (band 2)') because the manual names the parameter only collectively.
notes.safety: Documentation only. This map authorises no MIDI transmission; system rows such as CLOCK, INPUT and ROUTING stay excluded from hardware tests (TC-ELECTRONIC-M3000.md §11).
